# Testing Requirements Quality Checklist: Automated Test Coverage Expansion

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements in spec.md for contract tests, component tests, and coverage enforcement are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the "core frontend components" that require tests explicitly enumerated at the requirement level? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the full set of "key user interactions" requiring tests specified, beyond the three named examples? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the expected response "shape" assertions for each endpoint defined as requirements, or deferred entirely to test implementation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the coverage exclusions (generated UI primitives, config, migrations) specified at the requirement level? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the not-found (404) contract case specified for every endpoint where a record can be missing? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK006 Is the 60% threshold explicit about which metrics are gated (lines/statements) versus tracked (branches/functions)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK007 Can "deterministic" / "0 flaky failures across repeated runs" be measured with a defined number of repeated runs? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "core frontend components" defined with objective inclusion criteria rather than left to interpretation? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the 5-minute suite target anchored to a defined environment/hardware baseline? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "isolated test data" clear about the isolation mechanism (per-test vs per-file setup/teardown)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are the contract-test approach requirements (real app + isolated test DB) consistent between the Clarifications and FR-001/FR-005? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications/§FR-001]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the 60% threshold requirement remain consistent with the "meaningful yet achievable" edge case (no conflicting higher target stated elsewhere)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008/§Edge Cases]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for handling asynchronous UI behavior (awaiting) to prevent flaky results? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements specified for test behavior when the test database is unavailable? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the requirement that a breaking contract change fails at least one test stated measurably? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK016 Is the dependency on the CI pipeline (feature 008) for automatic execution captured as a documented dependency? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the coordination with the backend service feature (an app entry point for contract tests) documented rather than left implicit? [Dependency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the assumption of a specific component-testing approach flagged as not affecting any technology-agnostic testable requirement? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
